posts.title: codn — A Native Linux App for Terminal Coding Agents
posts.description: codn is a native Linux app in Rust that runs Claude Code, Codex and shells as real CLIs in terminals and shows which session is waiting for you.

posts.title: The Asus DSL-AC87VG: Reverse Engineering a CGI API
posts.description: No JSON API — just raw JavaScript. How I extracted router data from the Asus DSL-AC87VG using regex, a CSRF token hidden in a GIF, and positional arrays.

posts.title: The Speedport Plus 2: Reverse Engineering an Encrypted API
posts.description: The Speedport Plus 2 encrypts its API with SJCL AES-CCM. No docs, no SDK — just DevTools, a five-step auth flow, and a Python client.
